title: A day at the art museum
scene: Anna takes Max to the art museum. They see Renaissance portraits and a Madonna full of symbolism, the contour of a face in an indigo drawing, statues by a famous sculptor on stone pedestals, antique furniture and modern realism; a realist painter's panorama of Kyiv makes a critic and the curator smile.

words.ex: I like modern art.
Florence was the center of the Renaissance.
Can you take a portrait of me by the window?
The museum has a famous painting of the Madonna.
The poem is full of religious symbolism.
Draw the contour of the face first.
The sculptor worked on the statue for a year.
The statue stands on a stone pedestal.
This old clock is a valuable antique.
The painting is a fine example of realism.
I read what the critics say before I watch a movie.
The curator chose the paintings for the show.
This photo has very strong contrast.
The art critic praised the new exhibit.

old_story: On Saturday, Anna takes Max to the [[art]] museum. First, they visit the [[Renaissance|renaissance]] room. Max likes a [[portrait]] of a young man in a red hat. Anna likes a painting of the [[Madonna|madonna]] with a baby. The guide says it is full of [[symbolism]]. Next, Anna looks at the [[contour]] of a face in a drawing. Then they see statues by a famous [[sculptor]]. Each statue stands on a stone [[pedestal]]. Max wants to sit on a chair, but it is an [[antique]]! Upstairs, there are modern paintings in the style of [[realism]]. A [[critic]] writes notes in front of a big painting of Kyiv. The [[curator]] explains the strong [[contrast]] of dark and light colors.

title: Street art in Kyiv
scene: Max shows Anna street art in an old district: graffiti, a huge mural and public art on the exterior of old buildings. In an art space they see contemporary art, collages, avant-garde visuals and posters by an illustrator, and an art critic talks about design, designers and contrast.

words.ex: The wall near the station is covered with graffiti.
A huge mural covers the side of the school.
The city spends money on public art every year.
The exterior of the house is painted white.
The old factory is now an art space for young artists.
The museum has a large collection of contemporary art.
The museum has a new show about the avant-garde.
The illustrator drew all the pictures for this children's book.
Do you like the design of this phone?
I work as a web designer from home.
The designer made a bright visual for the ad.
The dress was dyed with indigo.
The building has a beautiful stone facade.

old_story: Max shows Anna an old district of Kyiv. Every wall near the station has [[graffiti]] on it. On one house, there is a huge [[mural]] of a big bird. "The city pays for this [[public art]]," Max says. The bird covers the whole [[exterior]] in [[indigo]] and white. Next, they go into an [[art space]] in an old factory. It shows [[contemporary art]] by young artists. One room is full of [[avant-garde]] pictures. Anna buys a [[poster]] by a local [[illustrator]]. An [[art critic]] talks about [[design]] with a young [[designer]]. She shows him a bright [[visual]] for a concert. At home, Anna puts her new picture on the wall.

title: What shall we watch?
scene: Anna and Max cannot choose a film on their streaming service. They watch trailers, read the rating and argue about the genre - a thriller, sci-fi about a cyborg or fantasy - and Max gives a spoiler about the sequel of a summer blockbuster.

words.ex: I like this film.
Which streaming service do you use for movies?
Have you seen the trailer for the new movie?
This movie has a very high rating online.
What genre of music do you like best?
We watched a scary thriller last night.
My brother loves sci-fi movies about space travel.
I love reading fantasy books before bed.
Don't tell me the ending, that's a spoiler!
The sequel was better than the first movie.
The summer blockbuster made millions.
Streaming has replaced DVDs for most people.
We watched a preview of the new movie.
We watched the promo for the new show.
The popular show got its own spin-off last year.
The remake is better than the original movie.

old_story: On Friday evening, Anna and Max want to watch a [[film]]. They open their [[streaming service]], but they cannot choose. First, they watch three [[trailers|trailer]]. Anna checks the [[rating]] of each movie. They argue about the [[genre]]. Anna wants a [[thriller]], but Max wants [[sci-fi]]. His movie is about a [[cyborg]] who saves a city. "What about [[fantasy]]?" Anna asks. Then Max gives a [[spoiler]] about the [[sequel]] of a summer [[blockbuster]]. Anna throws a pillow at him, and they watch a comedy.

title: Max's favorite TV show
scene: Every Thursday at prime time Max watches a new episode of his favorite sitcom, and Grandma prefers a game show. Taras likes a reality show, Mama watches a talk show with a funny gag and a cooking segment, but Max says streaming is better entertainment and sends a promo clip to Anna.

words.ex: The show is on TV during prime time on Thursdays.
I watched the first episode last night.
We watched an old sitcom on TV last night.
My grandmother watches a game show every evening.
I like this TV show.
She was on a cooking reality show last year.
She was a guest on a late-night talk show.
The movie has a funny gag about a dog.
Is there any entertainment for kids here?
The next segment of the show is about food.
Our school talent show is next Friday.

old_story: On Thursdays at [[prime time]], the family watches TV together. But everyone wants a different [[show]]. Max wants a new [[episode]] of his favorite [[sitcom]]. Grandma prefers a [[game show]] with big prizes. Taras loves a [[reality show]] about young cooks. Mom wants a [[talk show]] with a funny [[gag]] about a cat. Its next [[segment]] is about healthy food. Max sighs and says, "[[Streaming|streaming]] is better [[entertainment]]!" He goes to his room with his laptop. He sends Anna a [[promo]] for a new [[spin-off]]. Then he sends her a short [[clip]], and she laughs.

title: Taras's comics and anime
scene: Taras watches anime every night. His favorite hero has an alter ego like Superman, and his only weakness is like kryptonite; a cold sociopath villain with many minions, a droid and an ogre lives in a creepy castle with a vampire, and Taras also reads the hobbit saga.

words.ex: My son watches anime every evening.
He works three jobs like a superman.
Chocolate is my kryptonite, so I never buy it.
The villain sent his minions to find the hero.
The droid beeped and rolled away.
This old house looks really creepy at night.
In old stories, vampires only come out at night.
The family saga covers three generations.
The movie is about a tribe of cannibals.
The movie is about an android that looks human.
Our robot cleans the floor every day.
The movie is about a cyborg police officer.
He is just the boss's lackey.
My son reads manga every night before bed.

old_story: Taras watches [[anime]] every night after dinner. His favorite hero is a shy boy at school. But his [[alter ego]] is strong and fast, like a [[superman]]. His only weakness is cold water. It is his [[kryptonite]]. The villain is a cold [[sociopath]] with many [[minions|minion]]. He also has a [[droid]] and an angry [[ogre]]. They all live in a [[creepy]] castle with an old [[vampire]]. The vampire is funny, and the ogre is not a [[cannibal]]. He only eats soup! Before bed, Taras reads a book about a [[hobbit]]. It is a long [[saga]], and he loves every page. Tonight he falls asleep with the book on his face.
